input_fields.name: target_range
input_fields.description: One explicit model, selection, or component range to fit in the viewport.

input_fields.name: fit_command
input_fields.description: One verified Zoom Extents/fit control for the current release.

result_fields.name: fitted_view
result_fields.description: Target range, fit control, visible bounds, clipping observation, and geometry-unchanged state.

procedure: Resolve target_range and confirm whether the command fits the whole design or only the current selection.
Issue exactly one calibrated Alt+Z action or one verified View-menu Zoom Extents command.
Observe all target bounds and padding in the viewport, then return fitted_view.
If the target remains clipped or the command scope is unclear, stop with needs_manual_review.
rejection_rules: Reject an absent/ambiguous target range, blocked viewport, unknown fit scope, or a result that cannot be observed.
Do not claim full-model fit from a partial screenshot.
Do not modify geometry to improve framing.
